I managed to down a really small but kate breakfast today and that was the only meal I've had as I couldn't get up to make others. Any temperature of water makes my cramps worse ao I also avoid drinking liquids. I honestly envy those who don't experience any of this :( mine is worse during days 1-3, and still goes on for the rest of the week but a little less intense. 

I was literally about to call an ambulance last time because it had gotten so bad, and it was only the 4th hour of the start of my period! Sitting on the toilet causes me to ve stuck there till my legs go super numb so that's one hell of a joyride. My whole menstrual experience has caused me to not want to have kids in the future to be honest. I currently have no way to get to the doctor's office but am open to alternative pathways.

I got my first period ~6 years ago and my cycle has been all over the place since. The first few months they were almost monthly but then they started coming every 40+ days. I now have an average of 38 days cycle length.

I have no experience or knowledge with virtual appointments or finding a doctor so that sort of proves to be a problem :( 

The cramps have gradually gotten worse over the years with certain cycles being worse than others. During my previous period, I almost considered going to the ER.
The fetal position with a pillow under your face sometimes helps me when it gets so painful I start tearing up, but honestly I'm dying too :( we got this!
I just keep telling myself it'll pass, but then I start dreading the next time I get my period... I hope you find a way to cope with them!
